title: Night 3
intro: Vance's bedroll is in the generator room, wedged between the drums. You didn't put it there. Tonight Dispatch wants the north mast inspected.
newTonight: Your nerves. Darkness and cold wear them down; light, warmth, the radio and doing the job build them back up. Rations from the supply room help.
The fuel line can freeze. The generator sputters and drinks fuel. Take the heat gun from the supply room and hold USE at the generator to thaw it.
The yard. The outer airlock door opens tonight. Dispatch wants the north mast inspected once a night: follow the tether from the airlock to the red beacon and hold USE on the instrument box.
Outside, your body heat drains, and faster in a gust. The fuel shed east of the station has the rest of tonight's jerry cans. Close the outer door behind you.
Ice can build on the mast antenna. The radio and the met console go to static until you knock it off.
